question: Which directly measured HLA-bound peptides, if any, are publicly observed in authentic EMC specimens/models, and can they establish a new useful antigen-presentation phenotype beyond prior RNA predictions?
prior_gate: Review original tumor immunopeptidome/ligandome studies, supplements, repositories and epitope resources including broader sarcoma cohorts and historical diagnoses. September sprint notes mark prior presentation routes blocked, but are not proof of current source absence. A normal-tissue-only atlas cannot supply EMC presentation. Do not repeat bulk HLA RNA analysis.
pilot: Authenticate every eligible EMC specimen/model/condition, donor overlap, HLA allele, assay type, peptide-spectrum/FDR provenance and actual measured sequence. Freeze exact biological contrast/peptide criteria/normal controls/uncertainty before values. Assess processed measurements first; raw spectrum validation if required and feasible. A peptide from tumor tissue does not automatically localize to tumor cells, prove immunogenicity,dependency,benefit or safety. No fusion-peptide claim from prediction alone.
value: A newly supported presented antigen source could change an EMC vaccine/T-cell experiment; an already published list or source inventory alone does not qualify.
restrictions: Read current AGENTS.md and OPERATING_PROTOCOL.md. Daily America/New_York06:00 inclusive-10:00 exclusive prohibits UI/browser/headless/screenshots; check time before each operation; Sept12 exception expired; quiet file/API work allowed and do not interfere with children. No supported browser currently available. Keep10GiB free; measure before larger output/download; reuse installed dependencies and existing worktrees/sources. No paid resources,outreach,submission/publication,external scientific-record writes,PR,commit or push. Complete claim-relevant public EMC evaluation, controls/uncertainty/independence checks and automatic contrary-evidence follow-through; preserve original hypotheses and append amendments. No convenience sampling of eligible EMC or advancement while suitable accessible evidence remains pending. No TMEM266 revival, surface reranking or manuscripts without worthwhile contribution.
